policyVersions.summary: The first version. Three texts were merged to main under this one label, which must never happen again. (1) 1b8c08c, PR #6, merged 2026-11-23 19:42 -05: Spanish only; the controller named as Fundación OPTA, with its NIT and address left as [PENDIENTE] placeholders; the data section also named an optional answer about how the person wants to take part. (2) 97baa9d, PR #9, merged 2026-11-24 06:55 -05: English added; the controller named as Fundación Embajadores de la Paz, responsible for OPTA, with NIT and address; the retention sentence; the consent wording changed to match. (3) a34d4e5, PR #11, merged 2026-11-24 12:39 -05: adds the section on messages by WhatsApp or e-mail. The hash is of text 3, still on main. Commit dates are merge dates; when each deploy went live is not recorded. A person listed under this label must be matched to a text by the date they signed up.
policyVersions.subjectsTold: No record that anyone was told when the text changed under this label. Whether anyone signed up under it is open (check-subscribers-before-publish).

policyVersions.summary: Replaces 2026-11-draft (its text 3). Adds the link a sign-up came through and its use (counting sign-ups per link), the visit measurement with Plausible and the language cookie, Plausible among the providers, a section on how to exercise rights with who attends them and the terms, the rest of the rights, the list's lifetime with a yearly reminder, the privacy address in the controller section and the effective date. Names the controller as responsible for Ruta Opta rather than OPTA. Says for which e-mails the unsubscribe link works, those with the news, and adds the codes the sign-up protection keeps, which are not deleted automatically for now. The consent wording changes and takes two layers: a label that names Fundación Embajadores de la Paz (Ruta Opta) and the purposes, the per-link count included, and a notice under it with what a person can do with their data, the privacy address, the phone and the link to the policy. Published on 2026-11-26: pull request #16, merged as 2a039a5, deployed and checked live. Its effective line says 25 November 2026, by the owner's decision of 2026-11-26.
